title: RoMeRL: Balancing Feedback Coverage and the Memory-Reward Trap in Self-Evolving Agent Memory via Reduced-Order Utility States
title_zh: RoMeRL：通过降阶效用状态平衡自进化 Agent 记忆中的反馈覆盖与记忆-奖励陷阱
abstract_en: Learning-based memory systems for self-evolving LLM agents face two tightly coupled challenges. First, trajectory-indexed utilities grow with the interaction history, thereby dispersing limited feedback over an ever-expanding state space. Second, because trajectory-level rewards are jointly assigned to co-retrieved memories, irrelevant experiences may receive misleading utility updates and consequently enter the memory-reward trap. To address these challenges, we introduce Reduced-Order Memory Reinforcement Learning (RoMeRL), which represents the growing trajectory-indexed utility space using a fixed-dimensional per-task memory state factorized by outcome polarity and memory dynamics. RoMeRL incorporates new experiences through a fixed set of semantic coordinates whose contents are updated or replaced over time, thereby concentrating feedback over a bounded utility support. Theoretically, we show that this reduced-order parameterization increases the average feedback received by each utility coordinate and characterize the steady-state occupancy of erroneous coordinates under a generic coordinate-transition model. Empirically, across ALFWorld and LifelongAgentBench, RoMeRL improves task performance, reduces the Cold-Q ratio by 80.0%, increases feedback density by approximately 6.0 times, reduces the maintained memory size by 84.4%, and cuts LLM calls by 21.1%. These results show that reduced-order utility states support efficient self-evolving agent memory while limiting persistent reward contamination. Code is available at: https://github.com/YOUNG-fnxm/RoMeRL
abstract_zh: 面向自进化 LLM agents 的学习型记忆系统面临两个耦合难题：一是基于轨迹索引的效用会随交互历史增长，使有限反馈被分散到不断扩大的状态空间；二是轨迹级奖励会共同分配给被同时检索的记忆，导致无关经验也可能获得误导性效用更新，陷入 memory-reward trap。本文提出 Reduced-Order Memory Reinforcement Learning（RoMeRL），用固定维度的逐任务记忆状态表示不断增长的轨迹索引效用空间，并按结果极性（outcome polarity）与记忆动态（memory dynamics）进行因子分解。RoMeRL 通过一组固定语义坐标纳入新经验，坐标内容可随时间更新或替换，从而将反馈集中在有界效用支撑上。理论上，作者证明该降阶参数化能提高每个效用坐标获得的平均反馈，并在通用坐标转移模型下刻画错误坐标的稳态占据。实验显示，在 ALFWorld 与 LifelongAgentBench 上，RoMeRL 提升任务性能，将 Cold-Q ratio 降低 80.0%，使反馈密度提升约 6.0 倍，维护记忆规模减少 84.4%，LLM 调用减少 21.1%。
key_points_zh: 提出 RoMeRL，将不断增长的轨迹级记忆效用空间压缩为固定维度的 per-task memory state，缓解反馈稀疏与状态空间膨胀问题。
通过 outcome polarity 与 memory dynamics 对记忆状态进行因子分解，并使用固定语义坐标来更新或替换经验，使反馈集中到有界坐标集合。
针对 memory-reward trap，RoMeRL 降低无关记忆因共同检索而被错误奖励污染的长期风险，并从理论上分析错误坐标的稳态占据。
在 ALFWorld 和 LifelongAgentBench 上，RoMeRL 提升任务表现，同时将 Cold-Q ratio 降低 80.0%、反馈密度提升约 6 倍。
系统效率显著提升：维护记忆规模减少 84.4%，LLM calls 减少 21.1%，表明其适合更高效的自进化 Agent 记忆管理。

llm_assessment.comment: RoMeRL tackles a core self-evolving agent memory problem with a reusable reduced-order feedback mechanism and strong evidence on agent environments.
llm_assessment.comment_zh: RoMeRL 针对自演化代理记忆中的核心反馈稀疏与污染问题提出了可复用机制，并在代理环境中给出较强证据。
